limitations: Four category prompts with repeated neutral background; not realistic long-context task certification or a promotion gate.
32 greedy output tokens; numerical checks use eight teacher-forced steps.
Sequential arms, not randomized interleaving; no causal small-speedup claim.
Allocator tracking is not whole-device memory. DMS resident bytes and post-request snapshots have different lifetimes.

set -eu

runner_recipe:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/dms-compare-results
model=/models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf
local_metadata="$HOME/dms-artifacts/qwen38-external-v1/sidecar/dms_metadata.json"
published_metadata="$HOME/dms-artifacts/qwen38-published-w8192-8fe5fd45/dms_metadata.json"
failed=0
for arm in dense local-w256 published-w8192; do
  extra=()
  case "$arm" in
    local-w256) extra=(--metadata "$local_metadata");;
    published-w8192) extra=(--metadata "$published_metadata");;
  esac
  echo "START public $arm $(date -Is)"
  .venv/bin/python scripts/dms_public_sidecar_compare.py --model "$model" --arm "$arm" "${extra[@]}" --output "/tmp/dms-compare-results/$arm.json"
  rc=$?
  echo "END public $arm exit=$rc $(date -Is)"
  if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then failed=1; fi
done
for arm in local-w256 published-w8192; do
  metadata="$local_metadata"
  if [ "$arm" = published-w8192 ]; then metadata="$published_metadata"; fi
  for length in 2048 12288; do
    echo "START quality $arm $length $(date -Is)"
    .venv/bin/python scripts/qwen38_dms_integrated_quality_suite.py --model "$model" --metadata "$metadata" --data-manifest /tmp/dms-compare-results/dense.prompts.json --prompt-tokens "$length" --prompt-split "$length" --decode-steps 8 --modes no_evict,sidecar --codec int8_evaluation --backend hip_gfx1151 --output "/tmp/dms-compare-results/$arm-quality-$length.json"
    rc=$?
    echo "END quality $arm $length exit=$rc $(date -Is)"
    if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ]; then failed=1; fi
  done
done
exit "$failed"
